question.text: Per Chapter 6, the DOCUMENT in which the AIF's fee-structure details (management fee rate, hurdle, catch-up, carry, expense caps, etc.) must be comprehensively disclosed to prospective investors is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 6 refers repeatedly to the PPM as the master disclosure document. SEBI AIF Regulations require all fee-structure terms, distribution waterfall, catch-up, hurdle, clawback to be disclosed in the PPM, with the PPM template being SEBI-prescribed. The Trap: A is the constitutive doc but not disclosure-focused; C is mutual-fund terminology; D is retrospective. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XIX-A, XIX-C. SEBI mandates template-PPM since 2020 and annual PPM audit. Manager's Pro-Tip: As IM, treat your PPM as a legal contract. SEBI now mandates ANNUAL PPM compliance audit (by an independent CA) — inconsistency between PPM disclosure and actual fee collection is now easier to spot. Keep fee logs reconciled to PPM weekly.
